title: Aranmanai Kavalan
desc: Sakthi takes upon himself to protect and fight for every Tamilian thriving in Mumbai. When he meets the wife of the late community-chief, he makes up his mind to resolve her family issues.

title: Navagraha Nayagi
desc: Goddess Maari Amman blesses those who sincerely pray to her and teaches a lesson to those who are involved in wrongdoings by performing miracles and healing.

title: Chinna Marumagal
desc: The eldest daughter-in-law of a family faces various hardships at the hands of her mother-in-law. The youngest daughter-in-law teaches her a lesson and makes her realise her mistakes.

title: Pudhuvai Managaram
desc: A pair of twin siblings set up an accident rescue unit to save people. Soon, their lives change when they rescue a mysterious girl.

title: Udhaya
desc: Udhaya falls in love with Vasanthi, but realises that she is already engaged. Later, when he is wrongly framed for a crime, she strives to prove his innocence.
